test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following types of seats is made of hardened alloys and pressed or shrunk into the cylinder head, often used in aluminium engines for better durability?
solution:
The correct answer is __Insert valve seats.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Insert valve seats__ are made of hardened alloys for better durability.
 
• They are pressed or shrunk into the cylinder head of an engine.
 
• This type of valve seat is widely used in aluminium engines.
 
• The hardened alloy material enhances the wear resistance of the valve seat.
 
• They provide better performance and extended lifespan for engines under high-stress conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Integral Valve Seats:**

 
 
• These are machined directly into the cylinder head material.
 
• Commonly used in cast iron cylinder heads.
 
 
 
• **Butterfly Valve Seats:**
 
 
• Used in butterfly valves, typically for flow control applications.
 
• They consist of a disk that rotates to open or close the valve.
 
 
 
• **Ring Valve Seats:**
 
 
• These are separate rings fitted into the cylinder head.
 
• They are often used as an alternative to integral seats for ease of replacement.
